title: The Stigmata of Aldo the Dwarf
description: The true story of Aldo Vacci of Sicily, a dwarf who experienced the stigmata in the 14th century, and was eventually imprisoned just because.
quote: Father, these wounds are not from the reigns of my carriage or the handles of my buckets.
altHero: in an old candle-lit church, Aldo Vacci is a dwarf talking to a taller man
